experiment: B3 level-blend gate, COMPLETED: both arms (RATES and ANCHOR) plus the joint arm, both sides, with the four pre-registered controls and a defect-subgroup restriction
verdict: NO SHIP, all three arms, both sides. Every arm regresses the PRIMARY metric on both sides (12 of 12 arm x side x cut cells negative except one +0.0015 hit/rates full_pool_km). The ANCHOR arm, scored here for the FIRST time, is the WORST arm and on the pitcher side exceeds MDE95 on all three cuts (-0.0265 / -0.0306 / -0.0161 vs 0.016), making it a measured LOSS rather than a null. Pre-registered no-ship condition 1.
primary_metric: pooled OOS Spearman, debuted_km, blend leg, forward-chained (efv_model.SCORED_YEARS 2020-2023, 4 time splits)

repo_state: NOTHING FLIPPED. Matrices in data/ untouched: every arm was built in memory and written only to a scratchpad.
what_this_adds_over_the_2026_07_30_recor: The ANCHOR arm (LEVEL_BLEND_ANCHOR_MOST_EXPOSED) had NEVER been scored. It is now, and it is the worst of the three arms on both sides.
The joint arm (both flags on) had never been scored. Also NO SHIP.
The four pre-registered controls were run despite there being no gain to defend, because they turned out to be diagnostic in the other direction.

The defect subgroup was restricted for the first time. The loss is CONCENTRATED where the defect lives: on rows where the champion scored the player on a MINORITY of his season (median 32-35 percent of it), every arm loses on both sides.

The RATES arm reproduces the 2026-07-30 sign and near-magnitude on TODAY's matrices (hit -0.0064 vs -0.0082 then; pit -0.0159 vs -0.0162 then), so that verdict is robust to three model-changing days of matrix drift.
mechanistic_reading: Two findings sharpen the 2026-07-30 hypothesis that the level a player HOLDS is itself signal. (1) The zero-information control reassigns each treated row's feature delta to a random OTHER treated row, holding the treated set and the delta distribution fixed. On 3 of 4 primary cells the REAL treatment scores BELOW that control band (hit/rates real -0.0064 vs control mean +0.0004; hit/anchor -0.0130 vs -0.0030, 0 of 20 controls worse; pit/rates -0.0159 vs -0.0040). Applying the re-anchor to the RIGHT players hurts more than applying the same-sized re-anchor to random players, which is the signature of removing information rather than adding noise. (2) The ANCHOR arm degrades rows it never touches: untouched test rows carry BYTE-IDENTICAL feature vectors under both arms, so their delta is pure coefficient contamination from refitting on a treated TRAINING matrix, and it is -0.0054 hit / -0.0278 pit. Re-keying level_rank and age_rel_level onto the most-exposed level does not merely mis-score the split-season players, it degrades the fit for everyone.
arias_consequence: Unchanged from 2026-07-30 and now doubly closed. The cliff stays. When franklin_arias crosses 50 AAA plate appearances his AA season leaves the feature set and his grade moves for a mechanical reason. Neither arm may be flipped to prevent that: the ANCHOR arm, which is the one that would hold him on AA, is the arm that loses most.
